ablations.label: 2 kb local CNN
ablations.implementation: DirectConditionalCNN exhaustively tiles each 196,608 bp shard into 96 non-overlapping 2,048 bp contexts, slices the same 128 bp targets, then reconstructs the exact parent IDs before the 896-bin crop; 2,259,947 parameters and 16x384 tile accumulation, exactly matching the long control's 98,304 target bins per optimizer step.

ablations.label: matched-parameter long-range candidate
ablations.implementation: DirectConditionalCNN at 196,608 bp with 2,259,947 parameters versus 2,248,306 for local PDACircuitFormer (+0.518%); no landmark mixing or causal residual decomposition.

ablations.label: mean-only landmark memory
ablations.implementation: Duplicates every regional mean so token count, attention tensors, 2,248,306 parameters, data exposure, and optimization match the local candidate exactly; only standardized salience routing is removed. It trains all four stages independently for every seed and does not inherit dual-statistic healthy weights.
